goal.objective:
Replace production matchmaking with source-faithful OG Xbox Halo 2 matchmaking written entirely in Rust. Execute the full ordered work and exit criteria in multiplayer/docs/matchmaking-rust-parity-audit-20261028.md and multiplayer/docs/matchmaking-rust-parity-gaps.json against the preserved master, multiplayer/docs/reference/halo2-original-matchmaking-master-v5.pdf. Maintain all twelve GAP records, 53 algorithm-owner IDs and G01-G12 acceptance gates.

Rust must own every production matchmaking algorithm, policy, API and state: profiles/catalogs; eligibility and matching-related parties/local seats/guests/clans; tickets/gatherings/queries/failed-session memory; ranks/player/clan XP; candidate scoring/sort/readiness; full assignment caller; RNG/map/full variants; matchmaking host/countdown/session transitions; admission/results; transactional exactly-once finalization and statistics namespaces. Prefer existing Rust crates/bridges or introduce a Rust service crate. Python adapters are temporary; Rust leaves behind an authoritative Python coordinator/API do not satisfy the goal. C++ retains native rendering/input/gameplay and typed IO/ABI integration without independent matchmaking policy. Existing original-oracle/test tooling may remain Python.

Start by reproducing and fixing the actual gathering-finalizer two-team mismatch: raw ranks 24,24,22,22,22,22,20,20 and seed 2 yield cost 24 versus Rust cost 0. Port/replay the original hopper getter/caller, flags, count/imbalance feasibility, raw weights/group order, weighted optimization, FFA/clan branches and permitted casual retry. The existing Rust leaves passed 256 cases/768 unchanged TU1.5 calls; caller/integration proof remains required.

Fix the reproduced guest average (30 versus advertised 26) and trace distinct raw/effective/persistent/public skill producers. Port established rank/search/candidate contracts faithfully. Replace random.choices/all-map admission with exact ordered LCG selection, map eligibility, clamps, duplicate rows, RNG ownership/call sequence and complete 304-byte settings, including original signed-short controls. Bind full settings/map/profile/executable/catalog/rank identities, roster/party/authority generations, expiry/replay protection and namespaces through admission/gameplay/results. Remove name-based Slayer fallback from compatibility profiles.

Implement and qualify host/QoS/world continuity and secure result/dispute/quarantine rules while preserving actual existing world/objective/role/clock/identity/departure state, Steam authorization, opaque identities, one-clan membership and secure idempotent transactions.

Retain full scope: seven families, 39 built-ins plus required historical variants/profiles, ranked/hidden casual, solo/party/signed-local/guest/clan, original-valid FFA/two-team/multi-team/large sessions, natural outcomes, departures/migration, results/XP/PCR/party return/requeue and custom/LAN/offline XP isolation. Keep executable-default and historical profiles distinct. Continue lawful historical/service recovery; never guess missing configuration, server ordering or arbitration. Label modern replacements and keep original evidence gaps open.

Use pinned originals and reproducible original/Rust comparisons, then full native online acceptance and actual delivered client/library/service/catalog/feature identity with restart/retry/config-change/rollback. Update operational docs and deviation/coverage ledgers. Do not mark complete from documentation, a build, leaf tests, shortened matches or a bounded profile.

Preserve concurrent dirty work, references and selected runtimes. Follow AGENTS.md and docs/TEST_STORAGE.md: run_tests.py for CMake; run_test.py/HALO2_TEST_SCRATCH for Cargo/compiler/oracle/capture outputs, bounded receipts and verified cleanup. Start heavy native builds with two jobs and one test job.
